invariants.rationale: The method requires a TextField parameter to operate on; if null, an exception would likely occur.
The configuration sets maxLength to -1 if textField.maxLength <= 0, otherwise passes through the value; thus at exit the field is at least -1.
If in password mode, the code accesses textField.keyboardType; a null value would likely be unsafe or incorrect.
textField.filter can be null or non-null, reflecting what the code handles. Both cases are considered.
getText() is used in the TextInputWrapper; it should not return null for normal TextField operation.
